name: Isilu

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu emerge to control the plane's auroras, bringing forty years of peace.
timeline.quote: The twin worldsoul of the plane had emerged again to control the ebb and flow of the plane's auroras

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Pendulum Year". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen seeks Ashling's help as Oona's consciousness reasserts itself, bringing news of Isilu and Morcant's plot; they travel to Goldmeadow.
timeline.quote: Ashling was approached by Maralen in her time of crisis

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling and the others fight the Shadowmoor-afflicted kithkin and Gilt-Leaf elves; Rhys catches Maralen and fatally strikes her as their pact demanded.
timeline.quote: Rhys managed to catch up to Maralen and fatally struck her just as their pact had demanded of him.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko reveals he orchestrated the ordeal, falsely convinced Maralen and Rhys of Oona's return, and cures his sister.
timeline.quote: Making amends, he cured his sister, and the two were able to reconcile.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu reunite, rebalancing the plane's cycle; Rhys, freed of the pact's magic, dissolves into Eirdu's light.
timeline.quote: Ashling then watched as he dissolved into Eirdu's light.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona's death collapses the artificial cycles, and the plane enters the Pendulum Year before Eirdu and Isilu restore balance.
timeline.quote: the plane entered what would be recorded as the Pendulum Year .

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys strikes Maralen with moonglove; Oko admits he roused Isilu and turned Rhys against her.
timeline.quote: Rhys struck her with the moonglove poison, ensuring her death

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu reemerge after the final Great Aurora to control the plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: They reemerged after the final Great Aurora to control the Plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor .

citation.text: "Worldsoul", section "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Morcant plans to poison Isilu with dawnglow, but Kirol and Ajani flee and later return to steal the dawnglow from her.
timeline.quote: stole the dawnglow from her, transforming her into her Shadowmoor aspect in the process

citation.text: "Lluwen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students accidentally wake Isilu in a chamber beyond carvings, and darkness floods the world.
timeline.quote: accidentally woke it

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow, plunging it into Shadowmoor, and the students flee toward Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: Isilu walked past the village, plunging a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into the darkness of Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lorwyn elves attack Isilu, kithkin join the fight, and Maralen and Tamira are poisoned with moonglow.
timeline.quote: Maralen and Tamira were injured with the deadly poison moonglow

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Abigale returns with Eirdu, and the two gods embrace, restoring balance.
timeline.quote: The two gods embraced, and balance was restored to the plane.

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Oona's control broken, Eirdu and Isilu reawaken and the day-night cycle begins to merge again.
timeline.quote: Eirdu and Isilu, were reawakened as the twin aspects of the plane began to merge once more

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Forty years later Oko returns and Maralen fears Oona's return; the siblings reconcile before Eirdu and Isilu.
timeline.quote: The siblings, rejoined for the first time in decades, reconciled in the presence of Eirdu and Isilu

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students prematurely awaken Isilu, spreading Shadowmoor unnaturally.
timeline.quote: The students prematurely awakened Isilu

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu awaken from the firmament as the aspects merge.
timeline.quote: two great beings awoke from the firmament above the plane: Eirdu, the incarnation of the sun, and Isilu, the incarnation of the moon.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Kirol studies cave paintings of incarnations of the sun and moon trading places.
timeline.quote: Incarnations of the sun and moon, trading places,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The students find the sleeping moon-headed creature from the paintings at the center of a silver-lit chamber.
timeline.quote: And there, at the center of the circle, was the moon-headed creature from the cave paintings.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Sanar, drawn by the creature's autumnal presence, crosses into the circle and touches its neck.
timeline.quote: He pressed his palm against the cool, smooth neck of the creature

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The creature wakes and roars, terrifying the students.
timeline.quote: Its eyes opened, lambent as two smaller moons, devoid of iris or pupil but patterned with the pits and craters of an actual moon.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Kirol yanks Sanar away from the creature and they flee as it stomps and sends a wave of near-solid darkness through the tunnel.
timeline.quote: Kirol darted forward, grabbing Sanar by the elbow, and yanked the smaller student away from the beast.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The darkness floods the meadow, turning day to night and transforming the landscape.
timeline.quote: the sky overhead erupted in stars, the sun becoming a thin eclipse ring of fire in the distance while the moon sprang to sudden, total fullness.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The students flee the darkness and the roaring beast; Sanar bolts first and Abigale escapes into the air.
timeline.quote: Sanar was the first to turn and bolt.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The moon-headed beast emerges from the dolmen gate and plods away, followed by darkness, and Tam staggers out in its wake.
timeline.quote: the head of the beast emerged through the dolmen gate, the moon at its crown growing brighter as soon as it was in the open air.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid introduces herself, explains that people tumble into Lorwyn since the metal invasion, and identifies the beast as Isilu.
timeline.quote: My name is Brigid Baeli, hero of Kinsbaile, and I'm pleased to welcome you to Lorwyn.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid says Isilu should be sleeping, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in their territories.
timeline.quote: It's supposed to be sleeping right now, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in our territories.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow and the darkness transforms the village into its Shadowmoor aspect.
timeline.quote: Everywhere the darkness touched, the city was transformed.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Kirol recounts how the students woke Isilu; Morcant says Isilu should not have awakened for about six months.
timeline.quote: Isilu shouldn't have awoken until a good six months from now.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Morcant explains her view of Eirdu and Isilu and sees Isilu's vulnerability as a chance to end the night forever and raise the Gilt-Leaf Empire again.
timeline.quote: If they could end the night forever, and welcome endless day in its place.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Morcant muses about killing the night with dawnglow mixed with summer dreams, horrifying Lluwen.
timeline.quote: With the weapons of the night, of course.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells Ashling their story, and Ashling reveals the elves and Morcant plan to kill the night beast with poisons.
timeline.quote: They're concocting a plan to kill the creature.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu approaches with a small green faerie flitting before it, and Maralen recognizes it as her brother.
timeline.quote: My brother,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: A line of elf torches appears while Isilu closes in, and the kithkin ready to fight.
timeline.quote: And all the while, Isilu came closer, the living night descending on the drowning dregs of day.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Elves advance on Maralen's party as the kithkin form a united wall and Isilu draws near with the faerie.
timeline.quote: The night-touched kithkin continued to ready their weapons and adjust their positions

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen greets the faerie as her brother, but it flits back to Isilu.
timeline.quote: You came home!

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu lowers its head to Ashling and begins circling the party protectively against the elves.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Kithkin arrows knock reliquaries from elves, freeing the sunlight elementals and transforming the elves into their Shadowmoor selves.
timeline.quote: gasped and changed, flesh and bone melting smoothly into their Shadowmoor selves.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko turns more elves into rabbits to protect Sanar and tells Rhys that raising arms against day is raising them against night.
timeline.quote: She serves Lorwyn, and I serve Shadowmoor.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Morcant transforms to her Shadowmoor self and bows apologetically to Isilu as the students flee with Lluwen to reach Maralen.
timeline.quote: We're going to see the queen,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu and Eirdu answer each other's calls and, instead of fighting, wrestle in play; Maralen declares the balance is here.
timeline.quote: Then Isilu returned the bow and pounced.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The elementals' dance ends; Isilu heads back toward its cavern as the night recedes and transformed kithkin and elves return to their Lorwyn selves.
timeline.quote: As the ribbons of night unwound, the transformed kithkin returned to their original states.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen thanks Oko for returning and tells everyone the night elemental awoke because the strangers' dreams hurt it.
timeline.quote: The night elemental awoke because your strange dreams hurt it.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu emerge after the downfall of Oona.
timeline.quote: They emerged after the downfall of Oona

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Isilu's presence turned day to night and neighbors against one another.
timeline.quote: Isilu's presence turned day to night, fellowship to suspicion, and neighbors against one another.

citation.text: Darkness Descends (Lorwyn Eclipsed, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Isilu drifted past and the half-buried stones began to wake.
timeline.quote: As Isilu drifted past in a swirl of shadow and moonlight, the strange, half-buried stones began to wake.

citation.text: Firdoch Core (Lorwyn Eclipsed, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The students accidentally wake the moon-headed elemental Isilu in a cave; fleeing, darkness floods the world and turns day to night.
timeline.quote: They found the moon-headed creature, the elemental Isilu , in a chamber beyond the carvings and accidentally woke it.

citation.text: "Abigale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid takes them to Goldmeadow, where Isilu turns the village to Shadowmoor and they flee toward Glen Elendra to seek Maralen.
timeline.quote: Isilu walked past the village, turning a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Abigale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Abigale falls into a tributary, is carried to merrows who take her to the sleeping Eirdu, who leads Isilu to its twin and restores balance between night and day.
timeline.quote: She led the elemental to its twin, and the balance between night and day was restored.

citation.text: "Abigale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko brings Isilu to Goldmeadow; the town becomes Mistmeadow and Brigid becomes her Shadowmoor self.
timeline.quote: for the first time in her long and storied life, Brigid became her Shadowmoor self.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Strixhaven students arrive via an Omenpath, awakening Isilu and destabilizing the plane.
timeline.quote: Their arrival brough about the disturbance and awakening of Isilu

citation.text: "Restoration of Balance", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves of Lys Alana under Morcant try to destroy Isilu with weaponized dawnglove to force permanent day.
timeline.quote: intending to establish a permanent day across the plane

citation.text: "Restoration of Balance", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu confront each other in a ritualized dance, ending the instability.
timeline.quote: Eirdu and Isilu confronted one another in a controlled, reciprocal display of power

citation.text: "Restoration of Balance", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students find carvings of two winged creatures and accidentally wake the moon-headed Isilu, whose darkness floods the world.
timeline.quote: They found the moon-headed creature, the elemental Isilu , in a chamber beyond the carvings and accidentally woke it.

citation.text: "Kirol", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow, turning it into Shadowmoor; Brigid tells the students to flee toward Maralen's palace.
timeline.quote: Isilu walked past the village, turning a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Kirol", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Morcant plans to poison Isilu with dawnglow and forces Kirol to harvest it; Ajani rescues Kirol from rimekin and Lluwen follows them.

citation.text: "Kirol", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isilu and Eirdu defeat the elven forces and embrace, restoring balance to the plane.
timeline.quote: The two gods embraced, and balance was restored to the plane.

timeline.summary: Isilu is joined by Eirdu and departs, restoring balance to the plane.

timeline.summary: The students accidentally wake Isilu, whose darkness floods the world.
timeline.quote: They found the moon-headed creature, the elemental Isilu , in a chamber beyond the carvings and accidentally woke it.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Abigale returns with Eirdu; the two gods embrace and balance is restored.
timeline.quote: The two gods embraced, and balance was restored to the plane.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
